_meta.description: Small hand-written query/ground-truth set for spring-projects/spring-petclinic, used to measure Java retrieval quality as part of the multi-language (Go/Python/Java/JS-React) retrieval fix effort.
_meta.grounding_note: File paths and method names fetched live via `gh api repos/spring-projects/spring-petclinic/contents/...` at dataset-authoring time (2026-09-08).

queries.query: Where are pet name and birth date validated when creating or editing a pet?
queries.ground_truth_answer_summary: PetValidator.validate in owner/PetValidator.java checks that a Pet has a non-blank name (rejecting with the 'required' error code) and that a new Pet has a type set, used as a Spring Validator on the create/update pet form.

queries.query: How is the list of veterinarians displayed with pagination?
queries.ground_truth_answer_summary: VetController.showVetList in vet/VetController.java fetches a page of vets via findPaginated and adds pagination metadata to the model for the vets list view.

queries.query: What caching configuration does the application use?
queries.ground_truth_answer_summary: CacheConfiguration.petclinicCacheConfigurationCustomizer in system/CacheConfiguration.java customizes the 'vets' JCache cache with a fixed TTL so the vets list is cached rather than hitting the database on every request.
